notes: Pay and ages are from the 2026 flyer and may change. Going to the event does not guarantee a job. Course fee discounts may be available for people who want to work for the city. Under-18 workers may need a Maryland work permit; the flyer does not say.
name: Summer Lifeguards, Swim Instructors and Front Desk (Rockville Swim and Fitness Center)
org: City of Rockville Recreation and Parks
what_you_do: Work summer jobs at the city swim center as a lifeguard, swim instructor or front desk aide. The city offers lifeguard training if you are not certified.
who_can_apply: Lifeguards must be 15 or older. Swim instructors 15 or older with teaching experience (14 or older to volunteer with no experience). Front desk aides 16 or older.
pay_detail: 2026 flyer: lifeguard $18.25 to $19.25, swim instructor $18.75 to $20, front desk aide $17.65 to $19.00. Uncertified lifeguards start at $18.25 after they get certified.
deadline_text: The 2026 walk-in hiring event was March 23, 2026, 4 to 7 pm. 2027 dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Apply online at rockvillemd.gov/careers, then come to a hiring event or interview for a skills test (200 yard swim, 2 minute tread). Call 240-314-8750.
